==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|comply|-ance|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/kəmˈplaɪ.əns/|a=RP,GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-compliance.ogg|a=California}}
* {{IPA|en|/kəmˈplɑe.əns/|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|[kəmˈplɑe̯.əns]|a=NZ}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪəns|s=3}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# An act of [[comply]]ing.
#: {{co|en|strict '''compliance'''}}
#: {{co|en|regulatory '''compliance'''}}
#: {{co|en|full '''compliance'''}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The state of being [[compliant]].
#: {{ux|en|The software ensures '''compliance''' with data protection laws.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The tendency of conforming with or agreeing to the wishes of others.
#: {{ux|en|His quick '''compliance''' with the order impressed the officer.}}
# {{lb|en|mechanics}} A [[measure]] of the [[extension]] or [[displacement]] of a [[loaded]] [[structure]]; its [[flexibility]].
# {{lb|en|medicine}} The [[accuracy]] with which a [[patient]] [[follow]]s an [[agreed]] [[treatment]] [[plan]].
# {{lb|en|uncountable|business}} The [[department]] of a [[business]] that ensures all [[government]] [[regulation]]s are complied with.

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|compliancy}}

====Antonyms====
* {{l|en|non-compliance}}, {{l|en|noncompliance}}
* {{antsense|act of complying}} {{l|en|violation}}
